topic: AI companies destroy physical books – let's scan rare books before it's too late
headline: Preserve Rare Books Digitally
caption: As a full stack developer passionate about both tech and history, I see the potential here. Scanning rare books with AI not only preserves knowledge but makes it accessible worldwide. It’s crucial we act quickly to digitize these treasures before they disappear forever. Now is the time to build the tools that can efficiently catalog and store these digital copies. Let’s use our skills for preservation and education. What are your thoughts on AI helping save our cultural heritage? 📚
